ISS-access.name: Account hacked and lockouts
ISS-access.summary: Users report their accounts being hacked, emails changed, devices connected without consent, and being unable to log in or recover playlists.

ISS-billing.name: Unwanted charges after cancellation
ISS-billing.summary: Users are charged after cancelling or on free plans, get double-debited, or have auto-renewal payments continue without consent.

ISS-catalog.name: Missing songs and lyrics
ISS-catalog.summary: Users find songs, albums, and lyrics missing or not loading, and liked-songs content disappearing from the catalog.

ISS-downloads.name: Downloaded music keeps disappearing
ISS-downloads.summary: Users say their offline downloads and library are deleted or re-downloaded at lower quality, often after updates or payment issues.

ISS-other.name: Security, trust, and data concerns
ISS-other.summary: Users describe the app as corrupt, fraudulent, or unsafe, citing manipulated data, unauthorized device connections, and privacy worries about background sound collection.

ISS-playback.name: Excessive mobile data usage
ISS-playback.summary: Users report the app consuming mobile data in the background or through previews despite data-saving settings being enabled.

ISS-support.name: Poor customer support responses
ISS-support.summary: Users find customer service unresponsive or unhelpful, especially for hacked accounts, double withdrawals, and billing disputes.

ISS-usability.name: Liked songs deleted and poor recommendations
ISS-usability.summary: Users say their liked songs and playlists vanish without explanation, and that recommendations ignore their selections, mood, or disabled settings.

severity.1: No reported problem: praise, neutral or unclear content, or a pure feature request.
severity.2: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance, or a cosmetic issue; no functional loss stated.
severity.3: A degraded or restricted function; some use or a workaround remains (e.g. too many ads, features limited, intermittent stops).
severity.4: A core task is clearly blocked, e.g. cannot log in, cannot play music, app will not open.
severity.5: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm (e.g. charged wrongly, account data exposed).
